column1: # Word's storage width per integer attribute (CR-066 sections 3.1 and 3.4, measured on Word 365, 2026-10-26).
# Read by the inspector (InspectRanges, value.out_of_range) and by the oracle (text-extraction/support/inspect_oracle.py).
# element: the WordprocessingML element's local name; attribute: its attribute's local name; context: a sibling
# attribute's values that select the row (name=v1|v2; an empty alternative means absent; empty context: any),
# the first matching row in file order wins; storage: how Word stores the value, which gives its reading;
# range: the values Word keeps as written (lo..hi); evidence: the probe round and family.
# storage: int16, uint16, int32, uint8, uint5 (modulo the width, signed where int); pair-firstLine and pair-hanging
# (one int16 field, +firstLine or -hanging); rule-negated and rule-positive (the sign is the rule: exact stored as
# the negative; at zero "atLeast 0"); rule-negated-drop and rule-positive-drop (the same, the element dropped at
# zero); bits15-flag (the low 15 bits, bit 15 turns the exact rule off); int16-clamp, uint16-clamp, uint16-min
# (wrap, then the range column's clamp); column-w (a negative width is recomputed); column-space (a negative
# becomes -1); twips-unmeasured (an ST_TwipsMeasure attribute no round measured: outside -32768..65535 is changed,
# how is not known); ignored (the value is not 16-bit, or Word discards it: never a finding).
